items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: And the other doctors called him Dr. Fuller. Mmhmm. That's what we ever know. Dr. Fuller.

ctx.x: Let me move over here where Jack was sittin'. I think it'll pick me up better. Okay you can check it out. But uh what was the doctor's name?

One was named Lewis like I am. Mmhmm. Richard Lewis. And the other doctors called him Dr. Fuller. Mmhmm. That's what we ever know. Dr. Fuller. One was named Richard Lewis. Now they was kind of young doctors. They were old doctors. They were young. What would they tell the people? Well they just go and tell them what that medicine would do. You know it's like you tell them like it's good for rheumatism or cramp. You know a headache or different things. Well it was good medicine. Now they wouldn't be tellin' no…
You took it out? Did I take any of it?
